## Implementation Plan — #106: Layout Shell + Navigation

**Target**: `electron/packages/frontend-v2/src/`

### Sub-Tasks

| # | Description | Complexity | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Port shared library files (types, api, connections, format, cron, job-status) | light | none |
| 2 | Port SSE and connection hooks (useSSE, useConnectionStatus, useInstanceHealth) | light | 1 |
| 3 | Port ConnectionBanner and InstanceDialog components | light | 2 |
| 4 | Create TopBar component (instance dropdown, pill toggle, theme controls, settings) | complex | 1, 2, 3 |
| 5 | Create Jobs Sidebar (list + detail states, SSE-driven updates) | complex | 1, 2 |
| 6 | Create placeholder route pages (6 routes) | light | none |
| 7 | Create AppShell + React Router integration | standard | 3, 4, 5, 6 |
| 8 | Sub-navigation tabs infrastructure (sticky, static + dynamic closable) | standard | 7 |
| 9 | Layout and integration tests | standard | 7, 8 |

### Execution Waves
- **Wave 1**: Sub-Tasks 1, 6 (parallel)
- **Wave 2**: Sub-Task 2
- **Wave 3**: Sub-Tasks 3, 5 (parallel)
- **Wave 4**: Sub-Task 4
- **Wave 5**: Sub-Task 7
- **Wave 6**: Sub-Task 8
- **Wave 7**: Sub-Task 9
